cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""RoboPaint run record. All motions use the public robot client.
Target paths are derived from target.png; calibration uses camera images and proprioception.
"""
import sys, json, math, time
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot
OUT=Path('/app/output'); r=Robot()

def obs(name='obs'):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam','practice_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'],depth=True)
    o.save(str(OUT/name))
    for c,a in o.last.items(): Image.fromarray(a).save(OUT/(name+'_'+c+'.png'))
    return o

def send(a,note='move',dt=.05):
    a=np.asarray(a)
    results=[]
    for start in range(0,len(a),int(10/dt)):
        part=a[start:start+int(10/dt)]
        status=r.status(); n=status['calls']
        np.save(OUT/f'command_{n:04d}.npy',part)
        (OUT/f'command_{n:04d}.json').write_text(json.dumps({'note':note,'dt':dt,'type':'ee_pose'}))
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',part,dt=dt,cameras=['practice_cam','canvas_cam'],video='none',note=note)
        res.save(str(OUT/f'run_{n:04d}'))
        print(note,n,'tip',res.group('tcp_pose',now=True).round(6),'plan',res.meta.get('plan'),flush=True)
        results.append(res)
    return results[-1]

def move(pose,seconds=2,note='move'):
    o=r.get_obs(cameras=[]); p=o.group('tcp_pose',now=True)
    a=np.linspace(p,pose,round(seconds/.05)+1)[1:]
    a[:,3:]/=np.linalg.norm(a[:,3:],axis=1)[:,None]
    return send(a,note)

if __name__=='__main__':
    move([-.30,0,.25,0,1,0,0],3,'clear view')
    obs('clear')

def path_to_world(path,practice=False):
    path=np.array(path);uv=path.copy()
    if practice:
        x=-.1-(uv[:,1]-464)*.00022186
        y=-.19-(uv[:,0]-306)*.00022186
    else:
        x=-.1+(.5-(uv[:,1]+.5)/1024)*.22718
        y=(.5-(uv[:,0]+.5)/1024)*.22718
    return np.column_stack([x,y])

def write_path(path,practice=False,speed=.002,note='letter'):
    xy=path_to_world(path,practice)
    ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1)
    dist=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(ds)]; good=np.r_[True,np.diff(dist)>1e-10];xy=xy[good];dist=dist[good]
    t=np.linspace(0,dist[-1],int(np.ceil(dist[-1]/(speed*.05)))+1)
    xy=np.column_stack([np.interp(t,dist,xy[:,j]) for j in range(2)])
    q=[0,math.cos(math.radians(17.5)),math.sin(math.radians(17.5)),0]
    first=[*xy[0],.035,*q];move(first,3,note+' approach')
    send([first]*15,note+' align')
    touch=[*xy[0],.0192,*q];move(touch,1,note+' touch');send([touch]*15,note+' contact settle')
    poses=np.column_stack([xy,np.full(len(xy),.0192),np.tile(q,(len(xy),1))])
    send(poses,note+' pen pass');send([poses[-1]]*15,note+' end settle')
    move([*xy[-1],.04,*q],1,note+' lift')

 e=np.array([np.cos(np.deg2rad(angle)),-np.sin(np.deg2rad(angle))])*width/SCALE/2*ss
 p=(path-lo+.5)*ss

 for a in p:d.line([tuple(a-e),tuple(a+e)],fill=255,width=max(1,round(thin/SCALE*ss)))
 return np.array(im.resize((w,h),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)).astype(float)/255
